technical.summary: LDOS shows mixed bullish technicals with EMA golden cross and rising OBV, but overbought oscillators and weak trend strength limit entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: LDOS shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 63 days present elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 12) presents contrarian buy opportunity; weak congressional selling (small amounts, junior members, stale data 173+ days old) provides minimal bearish conviction; absence of recent news sentiment limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds with VIX in crisis territory (361), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, and earnings event in 63 days create a highly unfavourable risk environment for LDOS.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA golden cross and rising OBV provide technical momentum entry signal with price near support (99.25) and extreme fear sentiment offering contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (Stoch 89.88, Williams %R, StochRSI), weak trend confirmation (ADX false), price below 50-SMA and 200-EMA, macro crisis (VIX 361, flat yield curve), high earnings risk in 63 days, and zero fundamental/insider support create overwhelming headwinds.
